title: Telemetry tests assert on emission

facts.note: Filename colocation alone identifies a telemetry test, even without a URN kind segment.
URN kind segment on the test must be parsed from test names/annotations in the test file; a URN observer over test source is needed.
Produced by bun_tester_discipline_detector scanning telemetry-identified tests for emission-assertion patterns.

fires: A test whose URN carries a -TELEMETRY-, -EVENT- or -METRIC- kind segment only asserts on the function's return value.
A *.telemetry.test.ts file contains a test with no toHaveBeenCalled[With|Times] and no expectation on .emit/.emitted/.capture/.track/.record, even though it has no URN kind segment.
An existing, unchanged telemetry-identified test without an emission assertion is found when the validator scans the test suite.
doesNotFire: A test with no TELEMETRY/EVENT/METRIC URN segment in a file not named *.telemetry.test.* (not telemetry-identified, not scanned).
A telemetry test that asserts expect(emitSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(eventName, payload).
Non-test source files that emit telemetry.

given: A Bun test identified as a telemetry test by a -TELEMETRY-, -EVENT- or -METRIC- URN kind segment, or by *.telemetry.test.* filename colocation
when: the test exists in the suite (every telemetry-identified test, new, changed or unchanged, is scanned)
then: The test MUST contain an emission assertion: toHaveBeenCalled / toHaveBeenCalledWith / toHaveBeenCalledTimes on the emitter, or an expectation on .emit / .emitted / .capture / .track / .record.
prefer: Inject a spy or captured emitter and assert the emission, e.g.: const emit = mock(() => {}); placeOrder({ sku: "x" }, { emit }); expect(emit).toHaveBeenCalledWith("order_placed", { sku: "x" });
avoid: Asserting only the return value in a telemetry test: it proves the function ran, not that the event fired.
unless: Only telemetry-identified tests are in scope; tests without a TELEMETRY/EVENT/METRIC URN segment or *.telemetry.test.* filename are not scanned.
why: The event is the entire point of a telemetry test: dashboards, alerts and downstream analytics are built on the emission, not on the return value.
evidence: Every telemetry-identified test (URN kind segment or *.telemetry.test.* filename) contains at least one emission assertion; bun_tester_discipline_detector reports no finding.
verifier_detail: Telemetry test identification: URN kind segment -TELEMETRY-, -EVENT- or -METRIC-, OR filename matching *.telemetry.test.* (e.g. *.telemetry.test.ts). Filename colocation is a sufficient signal on its own; this is the one rule in the tester family where colocation is accepted alongside the URN, mirroring the Convex sibling.

Emission assertion patterns: toHaveBeenCalled, toHaveBeenCalledWith, toHaveBeenCalledTimes, or an expectation on .emit / .emitted / .capture / .track / .record. Note: the statement lists .record; the emission_assertion term definition lists only .emit/.emitted/.capture/.track — accept .record per the statement.
Scope: only telemetry-identified tests are scanned (all of them, regardless of whether they changed); the detector flags those with no emission assertion.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Bun realization of core tester.telemetry.emit, mirroring tester.convex.telemetry-emit.
Summary: Identifies telemetry tests from the URN or the filename and flags those with no emission assertion.

sharedNodes.text: strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; it has no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Non-test source files that emit telemetry.
additions.justification: Clarifies scope implied by 'Only telemetry-identified tests are scanned'; no new obligation.
